items.distractor_fact: Termometer di bandar bersebelahan mencatatkan bacaan {D}°C pada waktu yang sama.
items.gloss_en: The thermometer in the neighboring city recorded a reading of D°C at the same time.
items.entity_note: a different city's thermometer, not the city in the question

items.distractor_fact: Harga saham sebuah syarikat lain di bursa yang sama ditutup pada paras {D} pada hari itu.
items.gloss_en: The stock price of another company on the same exchange closed at a level of D that day.
items.entity_note: a different company's stock, not the company in the question

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah empangan lain di hilir sungai itu mencatatkan paras air pada bacaan {D} meter pada masa yang sama.
items.gloss_en: Another dam downstream on that river recorded its water level at a reading of D meters at the same time.

items.gloss_en: Another trader in the same market had an amount of money D at the start of that week.

items.gloss_en: Another school cooperative received a deposit of D into its fund in the same month.

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah kantin sekolah lain mengumpul wang jualan sebanyak {D} sepanjang hari yang sama.
items.gloss_en: Another school canteen collected sales money of D during that same day.

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah kad minyak lain ditambah nilai sebanyak {D} pada bulan yang sama.
items.gloss_en: Another fuel card was topped up with an amount D in the same month.
items.entity_note: a different fuel card, not the card in the question

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah pasukan bola sepak lain dalam liga yang sama menjaringkan sebanyak {D} gol sepanjang musim itu.
items.gloss_en: Another football team in the same league scored a count of D goals over that season.

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah syarikat lain dalam industri yang sama memperoleh pendapatan sebanyak {D} pada bulan tersebut.
items.gloss_en: Another company in the same industry earned income of D that month.
items.entity_note: a different company, not the company in the question

items.distractor_fact: Seorang petani lain di kawasan berdekatan mengumpul hasil tuaian sebanyak {D} kilogram pada musim yang sama.
items.gloss_en: Another farmer in a nearby area harvested a yield of D kilograms in the same season.
items.entity_note: a different farmer, not the farmer in the question

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah kilang lain di zon perindustrian berlainan menghasilkan sebanyak {D} unit barangan sebenar pada bulan yang sama, mengikut sasarannya sendiri yang tidak dinyatakan di sini.
items.gloss_en: Another factory in a different industrial zone produced an actual count of D units of goods in the same month, against its own target, not stated here.

items.distractor_fact: Seorang pemain golf lain mencatatkan sebanyak {D} pukulan pada padang golf yang berlainan pada hari yang sama, dengan par padang itu tidak dinyatakan di sini.
items.gloss_en: Another golfer recorded a count of D strokes on a different golf course on the same day, with that course's par not stated here.
items.entity_note: a different golfer on a different course whose par is not stated, not the golfer or course in the question

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah kereta api lain pada laluan yang berlainan tiba pada minit ke-{D} selepas jam rujukan stesennya sendiri.
items.gloss_en: Another train on a different line arrived at minute D after its own station's reference hour mark.

items.distractor_fact: Seorang juruukur lain di tapak yang berlainan mencatatkan ketinggian sebuah titik tanah pada bacaan {D} meter, menggunakan datum rujukannya sendiri.
items.gloss_en: Another surveyor at a different site recorded a ground point's elevation at a reading of D meters, using their own reference datum.
items.entity_note: a different surveyor with their own unstated benchmark datum, not the surveyor in the question

items.distractor_fact: Seorang murid lain bernama Murid C memperoleh sebanyak {D} markah dalam peperiksaan yang berlainan.
items.gloss_en: Another student named Student C scored a count of D marks in a different exam.
items.entity_note: a third student in a different exam, not Student A or Student B in the question's exam

items.gloss_en: Another tower named Menara Timur (East Tower), located in a different city, has a height of D meters.
items.entity_note: a third tower in a different city, not Menara Utara or Menara Selatan in the question

items.distractor_fact: Seorang pelari lain bernama Pelari Hijau mencatatkan masa tamat sebanyak {D} saat dalam perlumbaan yang berlainan.
items.gloss_en: Another runner named Pelari Hijau (Green Runner) recorded a finish time of D seconds in a different race.
items.entity_note: a third runner in a different race, not Pelari Merah or Pelari Biru in the question's race
